faqs.answer: We use local anaesthesia so you should not feel pain during treatment. Tell the dentist straight away if you feel discomfort and they will pause.

questions: Is there a dentist for kids?
faqs.answer: Yes, children are welcome. Please book a morning slot if you can, children are usually calmer earlier in the day.

questions: I have a toothache, what should I do?
faqs.answer: For a severe toothache, swelling or a broken tooth, send us a WhatsApp message and we will try to see you the same day. If there is heavy bleeding or swelling that affects breathing, go to a hospital emergency room.
